title: Cleanup-state exit label
statement: Let $k,L$ be natural numbers and let $M$ be a finite Boolean Turing machine. A cleanup state of type $pa(t_0)$ exits to the cleanup label for $pb(t_0)$ at phase $0$; one of type $pb(t_0)$ exits to the snapshot template with bit $t_0$ at program counter $0$; and one of type $lb(t_0)$ exits to the counter label for $lb(t_0)$ at phase $0$.
hypotheses_covered: a finite Boolean Turing machine M
